name: be-employee-income-tax
description: Belgian personal income tax (personenbelasting / impot des personnes physiques) for employees and pensioners who are Belgian residents, for income 2026 (assessment year 2027). Covers the art. 130 scale (25%, 40%, 45%, 50%), the tax-free amount of EUR 11,550 and its supplements for children and dependants, the 30% lump sum for employee expenses capped at EUR 6,070 versus actual costs, the fiscal work bonus, the pension and replacement income reduction, the main federal reductions (pension savings, long-term savings, gifts, childcare), the municipal surcharge, joint assessment and the marital quotient, the credit for payroll withholding (bedrijfsvoorheffing), the refund or balance, Tax-on-web filing, the simplified proposal, tax increases and late interest. Trigger on: Belgian tax return employee, aangifte personenbelasting, Tax-on-web, belastingvrije som, forfaitaire beroepskosten, huwelijksquotient, bedrijfsvoorheffing refund, voorstel vereenvoudigde aangifte, gemeentebelasting.
